patch_description:
The current program repeats the entire entanglement motif twice, which increases complexity (150 gates, depth 39) without improving worst-group margin (0.35 vs prior best 0.36). The key recommendation is to complete the CRX ring by adding the cyclic edge [7,0] under parameter "ent_nn", which was shown in generation 41 to boost margins without extra parameters.

Strategy:
1. Remove the redundant second motif (XX, CRX, YY, CRZ blocks) to return to a simpler, more generalizable structure
2. Add the cyclic CRX closure {"gate":"CRX","wires":[7,0],"param":"ent_nn"} immediately after the first CRX enrichment layer
3. This completes the nearest-neighbor CRX ring and should improve worst-group margin through better cyclic entanglement connectivity
4. Result: ~100 gates, depth ~20, single motif, cyclic completeness

This addresses the core bottleneck (worst-group margin) by improving the expressivity of the narrow-CRX layer while reducing overall complexity and improving generalization.
